identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a financial interface that feels like a Swiss vault—precise, secure, and visually commanding. Reject generic 'SaaS blue' templates.
identity.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) mixed with Jewel & Luxury (Archetype 5).

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Weight 900 for Hero, 700 for Section Headers.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, data tables, and inputs.

mono.usage: Use for financial figures, prediction scores, and ID numbers.

colors.theme_strategy: Smart Toggle (Default Light for Trust, Dark for Power Users)

gradients.hero_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-900 dark:from-emerald-400 dark:to-teal-200

cards.style: border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm rounded-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-6 py-2 rounded-sm font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-6 py-2 rounded-sm

inputs.style: h-11 rounded-sm border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

charts.style: Minimal axes, custom tooltips, responsive container

dashboard.layout: Grid with 4 key metric cards at top, followed by 2 large chart areas (Income Distribution, Loan Term) and a 'Recent Predictions' list.
dashboard.key_features: Quick Predict Widget (Sidebar or Top Right), Approval Rate Gauge.

prediction_form.layout: Two-column layout for inputs. Section headers: 'Personal Details', 'Financials', 'Loan Details'. Sticky 'Submit' bar.
prediction_form.interaction: Real-time validation. Confidence score reveals with a smooth counter animation.

history.layout: Data Table with sortable columns. Filter bar at top (Date, Status, Amount).
history.visuals: Status badges (Green pill for Approved, Red pill for Rejected).

analytics.layout: Masonry or Bento grid of charts. Correlation heatmap, Feature importance bar chart.

usage_rules.hero_bg: Use as a subtle background with heavy overlay (90% opacity) for the Dashboard header.
usage_rules.login_side: Use full height on the left side of the Login/Signup page.
usage_rules.abstract_graph: Use in the 'About' section or as a placeholder for empty states.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is APCA compliant. Use Slate-700 minimum on white.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. All graphs must have tooltips for screen readers.
accessibility.focus: Visible ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use Chivo.
Avoid standard 'SaaS Blue' (#2563EB). Use Deep Emerald or Slate.
Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary.
Every interaction must have a hover state.
Do not use native HTML inputs; use Shadcn components.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (kebab-case).

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup global CSS variables and font imports.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the Prediction Form using react-hook-form and Shadcn Form.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Integrate Recharts for the Analytics page.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Connect to FastAPI endpoints (mock if needed initially).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Polish with motion (framer-motion) and toast notifications (sonner).
